ضَجُورٌ : see ضَجِرٌ. ―
-b2- Also A she-camel that cries, or grumbles, (A, K,) much, (A,) on being milked, (A, K,) being distressed thereby. (A.) ―
-b3- It is said in a prov., applied to a niggard from whom property is obtained by degrees, notwithstanding his nig-
gardliness, إِنَّ الضَّجُورَ قَدْ تُحْلَبُ [Verily the she-camel that grumbles (or that grumbles much) on being milked is sometimes milked]. (A'Obeyd.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
